integrity: The proof combines an exhaustive four-position equality-pattern classification with analytic endpoint separation, de Bruijn constructions and a probabilistic argument. Finite tests are verification, not a substitute for universal steps. Independent scientific validation has not been carried out.
scientific_limitations: The exact least saturating length for alphabets of cardinality at least three is not determined. The limit law assumes uniformly independent input symbols. The full text of the 2026 substring-count hashing preprint was inaccessible; priority comparison with any subsidiary claims remains uncertain.
title: Sharp one-adjacent-swap dinucleotide-profile capacity and boundary law
